Check and plot disaggregated forecasts

Source: R/harmonise-splines.R
mt_disaggregate_check.Rd

mt_disaggregate_check() compares fine-age draws with the grouped draws they come from: the largest relative difference between the exposure-weighted mean of the fine rates and the group rate (0 when the group totals are kept) and the largest absolute second difference of the median log rates over age (large values mean kinks or oscillations). mt_plot_disaggregation() shows, for one forecast year, the group medians as steps and the fine-age medians as lines (type = "profile"), or the absolute second differences of the fine log rates by age as a heat map (type = "smoothness").

Usage

mt_disaggregate_check(grouped, fine, exposure)

mt_plot_disaggregation(
  grouped,
  fine,
  period = NULL,
  strata = NULL,
  type = c("profile", "smoothness")
)

Arguments

grouped

The mt_draws on age groups.

fine

The result of mt_disaggregate() for grouped.

exposure

The exposures used by mt_disaggregate().

period

Forecast year shown (default: the first).

strata

Stratum labels shown (default: all).

type

"profile" or "smoothness".

Value

mt_disaggregate_check(): a data.table per stratum and period with max_group_error and max_second_difference. mt_plot_disaggregation(): a ggplot object.

Examples

x <- mt_example(years = 2000:2019, deaths = "single")
xg <- mt_regroup(x, age = c(seq(30, 85, 5), 90))
fc <- mt_forecast(mt_fit(lee_carter(), xg), h = 3, n_draws = 20, seed = 1)
e <- mt_array(x, "exposure")[, 20, ]
sh <- mt_shape_rates(x, periods = 2020:2022)
fs <- mt_disaggregate(fc, mt_grid(x)$age, exposure = e, shape_rates = sh)
mt_disaggregate_check(fc, fs, e)
#>       sex  label period max_group_error max_second_difference
#>    <char> <char>  <num>           <num>                 <num>
#> 1: female female   2020    4.440892e-16             0.3116803
#> 2: female female   2021    4.440892e-16             0.3116803
#> 3: female female   2022    4.440892e-16             0.3116803
#> 4:   male   male   2020    4.440892e-16             0.2758296
#> 5:   male   male   2021    3.330669e-16             0.2758296
#> 6:   male   male   2022    4.440892e-16             0.2758296
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) mt_plot_disaggregation(fc, fs)
